newsitem.title: UK: Land Securities up on property growth hopes.
newsitem.headline: Land Securities up on property growth hopes.

text.p: Shares in Land Securities Plc led UK property stocks higher on Monday after positive comment on the sector's outlook in the Financial Times, dealers said.
Land Securities was up 14-1/2p at 755 by 0930 GMT, after earlier reaching a near two-year high of 756p.
A report in the FT said UK retailers and big employers were expecting to increase their commercial property holdings.
Citing a survey by the Confederation of British Industry, the FT said a net balance of six percent of companies planned to increase their propoerty holdings in the next six months.

Elsewhere in the sector, Slough Estates Plc was up 1-1/2p at 279-1/2 and Frogmore Estates Plc was up 2-1/2p at 566. MEPC Plc was up 3-1/2p at 440-1/2. Dealers said hopes for the property market were also boosted by a Sunday Times report that estate agent Savills was forecasting a 50 percent rise in UK house prices through the next three years.
"We saw a couple of buyers come in for Land Securities early on and the price was marked higher as a result," said one market-maker.
Last month Land Securities shares were boosted when BZW raised the stock to a "buy" from a "hold" and issued an "overweight" recommendation on the UK property sector.
